world_bible: Shire/Hobbiton visual grammar remains pastoral hills, lanes, farms, Hobbit-holes, warm domestic scale, circular doors and gardens.
Canonical landmarks remain visually dominant; decorative branches must serve story, resource/preparation, relationship/lore or meaningful traversal.
systems_bible: Foliage review focuses on instance density, cull distance, LOD, wind complexity and masked-material overdraw.
GPU review includes foliage overdraw and expensive materials; memory review includes textures and duplicated materials.
Profile representative Shire scenes before promoting density or universal budgets.

verified_pipeline_gap: The production importer synthesizes Color/Roughness/Metallic material instances but currently ignores authored map_Kd texture bindings.
No repository implementation currently contains SimpleGrassWind, WorldPositionOffset or a global wind material parameter path.
Existing Shire TGA textures are imported but are not yet guaranteed to drive the synthesized master-material base color.
drop_c_order: C1 bind authored albedo texture paths from MTL into deterministic production material instances
C2 add a dedicated lightweight foliage master with parameterized wind WPO for grass/leaves only
C3 assign foliage parents by stable material identity without changing gameplay IDs or world ownership
C4 retain HISM/LOD/cull bands and profile masked-overdraw/material cost before density increase
C5 prepare a later weather/audio shared wind parameter bridge after the visual material path is engine-green

material_contract.channel_packing: New PBR acquisitions should use channel-packed masks where useful; existing project-owned albedo TGAs remain valid source assets.
material_contract.runtime_loading: No new synchronous heavy asset loading.

performance_contract.target: i7 6th gen / 8 GB RAM / approx 2 GB VRAM / DX11 / 720p Low-Medium / 30 FPS floor
rules: Do not increase foliage instance density until target-device profiling.
Wind complexity must be cheaper at distance; distant vegetation may use reduced/no wind.
Masked-material overdraw and shadow cost are profiling gates, not assumptions.

external_sourcing.policy: Provider listing is not item approval; every asset requires provenance/license/scale/UV/material/LOD review.

acceptance: UE4.27.2 production import and core validation success.
Imported Shire material instances resolve authored texture parameters without broken references.
No project-owned material usage warning regression.
Owner PIE visual review confirms natural material response and non-distracting wind.
Target-device profiling confirms foliage/material cost before density expansion.
evidence_boundary: Planning/preparation only until runtime implementation starts after the current develop post-merge validation is green.
